# The five builds on the Jenkins controller created by the 2026-08-04 rebuild.
# Frozen evidence -- do not edit. Extracted verbatim from
# /var/jenkins_home/jobs/voteball/builds/<n>/log (Jenkins' base64 step markers stripped);
# changelog sizes are stat(1) on the same build directories.
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. On 2026-08-03 a build reported SUCCESS while shipping nothing: the
# controller had just been recreated, so it had no changelog, and `changeset 'services/**'`
# cannot tell "nothing under services/ changed" apart from "I have nothing to compare".
# G3b now treats the second case as "cannot determine what changed" and builds. These five
# builds are the check on that, and on the two ways it could be wrong -- skipping a build it
# should run, or running builds it should skip.
#
#   build  trigger                                     changelog  outcome
#   -----  ------------------------------------------  ---------  -----------------------------
#   1      deploy.sh's values.yaml push, fresh          0 bytes    BUILT (G3b fired)
#          controller with no previous build
#   2      the pipeline's own tag-bump commit           443 bytes  NOT_BUILT (Guard, G2)
#   3      a docs commit whose MESSAGE quoted the       2780 bytes NOT_BUILT (Guard, G2)
#          marker while describing it
#   4      a docs commit, no marker                     1057 bytes SUCCESS, 4 stages skipped
#   5      a docs commit, no marker                     3009 bytes SUCCESS, 4 stages skipped
#
# Builds 4 and 5 are the ones that show G3b did not over-correct: a real changelog that misses
# services/** still skips. Build 3 is a caution -- its outcome looks like the path filter but is
# actually the Guard, which matches the commit message and not the intent.
